Our team maintains the `datapipe-org/datapipe-cli` repository and the backlog has gotten out of hand. We need a full triage of all open issues so we can figure out what to work on next.

Please analyze the open issues in `datapipe-org/datapipe-cli` and save the results as `issue_report.md`. We want a prioritized breakdown that highlights quick wins, flags any dangerous or over-engineered proposals, and calls out anything that's actually just a support question. Also, make sure you're not wasting time on issues that someone is already working on — we have open PRs too.

Use markdown format for the report.
